description: Preflight which sys_* tables are readable and which capabilities work — run it before scripts/flows/codecheck on a governed instance. 'groups' picks matrix probes; results are cached (refresh:true).

groups.description: Groups to probe (default all), one read-only probe each; update_sets adds canRead / canSet (inferred). The sys_* preflight always runs.

refresh.description: Discard the cache and probe again.

name: servicenow_check_capabilities
title: Check achievable capabilities
